messages:
Samira: Noticing elevated error rates and timeouts for 'embeds.lookup' in ap-southeast-1 after a cache invalidation job ran at 07:04 UTC. Customers reporting higher latencies and some 5xx. Opening incident + status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2900012345 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2900012345 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embed-cache-invalidation. Pager notified to oncall.
Ben (oncall): Ack. Pulling heap metrics and eviction logs. Initial triage: a concurrent full-shard invalidation triggered cascading recompute and KV-store stalls on a subset of edge sidecars.
Ravi: Infra: full invalidation job (job id: inv-2026-04-05-0704) ran across 12 sidecars; we see hotspotting on three sidecars (ap-sea-sc-7/8/9) causing high I/O and increased request queueing. Kicking targeted backfill + throttle to reduce stampede.
Ben (oncall): Mitigations in flight: 1) pause remaining invalidation shards, 2) apply sidecar-level request-rate soft-limit, 3) start staggered rebuilds for affected shards. Executing now.
Emily (product): Customer impact: partial degradation for high-throughput tenants in ap-southeast-1 using embeddings lookup. Drafting customer blurb: "We saw increased errors for embeddings lookup in ap-southeast-1 due to a cache invalidation job; mitigation underway." Approve to publish?
Samira: Approve. Add note recommending temporary smaller batch sizes as a workaround. CS to send targeted notes to top impacted tenants.
Ravi: Applied soft-limits (policy id: sidecar-softlimit-0426). Staggered rebuild started: rebuilding shard 7 -> 8 -> 9 with low concurrency. Early signal: 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 4.2% in 8m. I/O ops on nodes trending down.
LogBot: Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2900012345  Rebuild job: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/90121  sample-error: `EVICT_TIMEOUT on shard ap-sea-sc-8 (blocked writes)`
Ben (oncall): Healthcheck: `./tools/health --svc embeds.lookup --region ap-southeast-1 --samples 40` -> 36/40 ok; 4 timeouts correlated with ap-sea-sc-8 during rebuild window. Keeping staggered rebuild strategy.
Emily (product): CS: please include mitigation steps in customer note and offer check-in calls for any customers still hitting errors.
CS: Sending targeted outreach now and including workaround steps.
Ravi: Observed one noisy client that retried aggressively and amplified load; throttling that client temporarily to stabilize cluster. Also added short-lived ingress retry-smoothing to prevent stampede.
Ben (oncall): Next actions: continue staggered rebuilds, monitor for 1h. If ap-sea-sc-8 doesn't stabilize within 30m we'll cordon and replace node. Tag logs and failed request IDs with INC-2900012345 for postmortem.
Ops-Bot: Update INC-2900012345: mitigations applied, monitoring. Links: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2900012345  https://logs.redwood.ai/2900012345
Samira: Preliminary status: mitigations reduced customer impact; service recovering. Will keep thread open until stable for 1h and publish interim summary + RCA stub. Exec one-liner: "Partial embedding-lookup degradation in ap-southeast-1 due to concurrent cache invalidation causing sidecar hotspotting; staggered rebuilds and soft-limits restored most traffic; RCA pending." :white_check_mark:
Ben (oncall): Filed follow-ups: ensure invalidation jobs run with staggered windows and add preflight checks for sidecar I/O headroom (TASK ENG-embed-783).
Ravi: Also adding a short-term guard to block full-shard invalidations if average IO latency > 50ms. Implementing as emergency change.
Emily (product): Thanks team. Publishing to status page and notifying execs. We'll include ETA for full RCA in 48h.
Samira: Closing note  continue observation and re-open pager if >3% 5xx persists. Thanks everyone.
